ancestry_policy: All variants/prefixes/arms belong to existing full4 TRAIN ancestor. Four new geometric declarations are NOT four independent families or heldout/TEST scenes.

sampling.ordering: round-major cyclic Latin arm order; launch eligible rows in ordinal order subject to Data capacity/lease and T priority; completion order may differ

physical_limits.original_guards: 12N, original4s, immutable/identity, whole-path guard, support, QP, FIFO, CLIMB stop unchanged

observation_coverage.causal_clock: FIRST ORIGINAL CLIMB PREPARE, same query/Observation/installed-before-first-command binding
observation_coverage.exact_proprio_diagnostic: round physical_features[2:47] to 6 decimals; report distinct counts/ranges and duplicates, not a meaningful-state or safety guarantee

stopping.common_source_identity_safety_or_guard_i: STOP_THIS_SOURCE_VERSION; retain every failure/charge; no reissue of closed rows
stopping.ordinary_individual_native_failure: Keep result and all attempt costs; no chasing success or whole-batch stop solely to hide failures
stopping.censored_or_unknown: Separate censoring and UNKNOWN; never fabricate a native negative/success time or drop an attempt
stopping.capacity_or_unqualified_row: No launch without Data own-zero/freeze/lease; leave explicit NOT_ADMITTED/NOT_STARTED, not a replacement
stopping.batch_end: Publish complete fixed inventory including not-started/failed/unreached/unknown; no automatic fit or extension to the other 36 matrix combinations

labels.success: Original CLIMB literal succeeded + READY/source and stop verified; current_READY_s/full_success_s relative to same first-PREPARE clock
labels.native_guard_failure: Only verified native failure AFTER decision, full_success_s=None; absent terminal receipt retained absent
labels.upstream_failure: Unreached decision, physical_features/outcome-for-critic/current_READY_s/full_success_s=None. Keep native failure reason in whole-attempt inventory.
labels.resource_failure: CENSORED, never native negative or successful cost
labels.missing_features_or_boundary: Explicit missing/UNKNOWN, no nearest/READY/zero imputation; no fit if existing validator cannot represent all actual attempts honestly
labels.cost: All scopes include zero/aux/main/failure/censor sim, wall, bytes; unknown cost lower bound. Successful conditional cost separately, never failure elapsed imputed as completion time.

training_activation: Collection only. Does NOT modify/append/refit the frozen TRAIN6 model or its CAL/VAL protocol. A separate prospectively fixed model-training/evaluation manifest and actual full-source/feature/label gate are required before any new model version; do not invoke old train-only on this TRAIN-only family registration.
priority: T-COMPLEX-01 full-program qualification/A-B/live video gets first eligible resources; bulk need not wait for all ten geometry groups, but never displaces T or hot-expands old scopes
